item.title: Brad Arnold ng 3 Doors Down, pumanaw sa edad 47
item.description: Sa isang statement ng banda ay sinabi nilang si Arnold, “passed away peacefully, surrounded by loved ones, in his sleep after his courageous battle with cancer”. Gayundin sa kanilang social media post, “he had helped redefine mainstream rock music, blending post-grunge accessibility with emotionally direct songwriting.”

item.title: EJ Obiena, wagi ng ginto sa Asian Indoor Athletics Championships
item.description: Isang attempt lamang ang kinailangan ni Obiena para ma-clear ang winning height na 5.70 meters sa finals, habang nabigo naman si Li Chenyang ng China sa lahat ng pagtatangka nito sa parehong bar dahilan para makakuha ng silver medal matapos lampasan ang 5.60m.
